installed.title: Installed Plugins

installed.empty_description: Browse the catalog tabs on the right to install a plugin.

confirm.uninstall: Uninstall {{slug}}? This runs the 7-step gate chain and is irreversible.
confirm.uninstall_warning: All saved data will be permanently lost. This includes configuration, plugin data tables, ABAC rules, the plugin's bundle files, and any widget or workflow-node instances. This cannot be undone and there is no automatic backup.
confirm.preview_error: Could not load impact summary. Uninstall will still proceed.
confirm.impact_empty: No contributions found — uninstall will remove only the bundle files.

impact.permissions_referenced: Granted in roles (grants will be removed)

confirm.data_loss_warning: This plugin stores data of its own, and uninstalling deletes it permanently. If the plugin offers an export, use it before continuing.
confirm.roles_strip_warning_one: {{count}} role still grants this plugin's permissions: {{roles}}. Uninstalling removes those grants from the role.
confirm.roles_strip_warning_other: {{count}} roles still grant this plugin's permissions: {{roles}}. Uninstalling removes those grants from the roles.
confirm.purge_label: Also clear this plugin’s stored data
confirm.purge_help: Removes the plugin’s saved settings and secrets, and any catalog source left behind for a category no other plugin provides. Leave unticked to keep them, so reinstalling finds its configuration intact.

errors.bundle_load_failed: Failed to download the plugin bundle.

errors.widget_load_failed: Plugin {{slug}} could not load its dashboard widget {{widget}}.

catalog.pickerHint: Pick a version to install. The latest is the default; pick an older release to pin or downgrade.

unsigned.title: This plugin is not signed
unsigned.description: McHarbor could not verify this plugin against a trusted signing key. It can run backend code, read your Docker and Kubernetes environments, and add pages to this UI. Install it only if you trust where it came from.
unsigned.acknowledge: I understand the risk and want to install this unsigned plugin.
unsigned.hostPrivileges: {{name}} runs as native code inside the McHarbor process, with the same access to this host as McHarbor itself.
unsigned.serverUnverified: The server could not verify this release against a trusted signing key, and will not install it until you confirm.

signature.signedTooltip: Verified against a trusted signing key.
signature.unsignedTooltip: No verified signature from a trusted key. Install at your own risk.

repair.explanation: This plugin did not load on this McHarbor. Repair fetches its copy from the catalog again.
repair.reconcileHint: Pin this plugin to catalog version {{version}}. The host keeps, moves or reinstalls it so the record, files and binary agree; role grants are kept.

card.builtForPrereleaseHost: Built for this prerelease host. If the plugin cannot load, the reason is shown below; update McHarbor to the next stable version to move it.

channels.saveFailed: Could not save the prerelease setting

store.label: Offer plugin prereleases
store.hint: Show test builds that are not final for every plugin. A plugin can also opt in on its details page.

override.label: Offer prereleases for this plugin
override.hint: Show this plugin's test builds even when the Plugin Store switch is off.
override.globalOn: On for every plugin in the Plugin Store.
override.followsOff: Prerelease offers are off for this plugin. The next stable will be offered.

return.title: Return {{name}} to stable?
return.summary: From {{from}} to {{to}}. Your data is kept.
return.checking: Checking whether {{name}} can return to stable...
return.ready: Ready to return. Nothing else blocks it.
return.blocked: Cannot return: the prerelease made a database change ({{migration}}) that the stable build does not include. Nothing was changed.
return.blockedGeneric: Cannot return: the check gave a result this version does not know. Nothing was changed.
return.noStable: No stable version of {{name}} is available.
return.prereleaseHost: Plugins follow this prerelease host and stay on its prerelease builds. They can return to stable once a newer stable McHarbor version is installed.
return.unsigned: This package has no signature, so McHarbor cannot confirm who made it. It was not opened. The database check can only run after you agree.
return.consent: I understand and want to return {{name}} using an unsigned package.
